results.text: Win ratio aligns with and enhances interpretation of REPRIEVE's primary findings. We performed a win ratio (WR) analysis of REPRIEVE, a randomized trial of pitavastatin vs placebo for CVD in people with HIV, to assess robustness to event severity. WR aligns with primary findings, and provides insight into pitavastatin protections: persistent advantage over placebo on CV Death, Stroke, and Myocardial Infarction.

results.text: A New Look at P Values for Randomized Clinical Trials. BACKGROUND: We have examined the primary efficacy results of 23,551 randomized clinical trials from the Cochrane Database of Systematic Reviews. METHODS: We estimate that the great majority of trials have much lower statistical power for actual effects than the 80 or 90% for the stated effect sizes.
